title: Romania
capsule: Following the December 1989 revolution that overthrew and executed Nicolae Ceaușescu, Romania adopted a new democratic constitution in 1991 establishing a semi-presidential republic, with Ion Iliescu elected its first post-communist president in 1990. The country joined NATO in 2004 and the European Union in 2007, and has since alternated between Iliescu, Emil Constantinescu, Traian Băsescu, Klaus Iohannis, and Nicușor Dan as president amid recurring corruption scandals and a contested, annulled 2024 presidential election that forced Iohannis's resignation in early 2025.
